project_context: Vertex AI - Redesign of landing page. Luxury dark mode with lime accents. Must be desktop and mobile friendly.

headings.style: Highly contrasting weights. Mix font-light (300) with font-bold (700) or font-black (900) in the same heading to create tension.
headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for navbar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0B0A]/80 border border-[#1A1C1A]. MUST have solid backdrop for readability.
visual_enhancers.clay_buttons: MUST KEEP: 3D tactile buttons (btn-clay). background: #CCFF00, text: #020302, font-weight: 600, border-radius: 9999px. Use box-shadow to create 3D effect (inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 4px 10px rgba(204,255,0,0.2)). On active, press down.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle radial gradients with lime_glow behind hero and pricing sections to break the void.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle noise/grain texture on #020302 background to create a physical luxury feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing on desktop, py-16 on mobile.
grids_and_layouts.features_bento: Asymmetric bento grid for 6 features. Desktop: grid-cols-12. E.g., row 1: col-span-7, col-span-5. row 2: col-span-4, col-span-4, col-span-4. row 3: col-span-12 or col-span-8 and col-span-4.
grids_and_layouts.pricing_layout: Two distinct columns (lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8). Left: Free Access card. Right: Buy License card. Make them asymmetrical in design.

sections.navbar: Sticky floating pill. Logo + 'Vertex AI' left, links center (hidden on mobile), CTA right. Keep as before.
sections.hero: H1: 'Trade with Intelligence. Win with Vertex AI.' with mixed font weights. Subcopy. Buttons: 'Get Vertex AI' (clay) and 'View Pricing' (outline/ghost). Glass hero card with animated SVG candlestick chart + floating 'BUY' marker + 'Powered by Vertex AI real-time algorithm'. Fading lime divider below card. REMOVE stats strip, REMOVE micro-labels.
sections.features: Title: 'Built for serious traders'. 6 features (Neural Signal Engine, Chart Vision AI, Smart Entry Routing, Robotic Execution Logic, Live Market Telemetry, Precision Risk Guard). REMOVE 01/02 numbering. Add lucide icons.
sections.how_it_works: 3 steps (Connect account, AI scans markets, Trade signals). Horizontal timeline flow with glowing connecting lines.
sections.pricing: Title: 'Choose your access'. Redesign completely. Free Access ($0): Step-by-step vertical list (Create Account, Deposit $50, Verify UID) inside card, 2 buttons at bottom. Buy License ($99/mo): VIP layout, 4 perks list, 'Purchase License' button. Give the $99/mo card a premium tracing beam border or glow.
sections.cta_band: Deep #111311 container, radial lime glow. 'Start your trading career with Vertex AI'. 'Create free account' clay button.
sections.footer: py-24. Top border #1A1C1A. Logo, Privacy Policy, Support, copyright. Distinct trading risk disclaimer box (border-[#1A1C1A] text-[#555955]).

motion.scroll: Fade up and stagger entrance for bento grid cards.
motion.buttons: Active state for clay buttons: translate-y-[2px] shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] to simulate physical press.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #CCFF00 on #020302 exceeds 4.5:1. For text on #CCFF00, use #020302.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for mobile menus and interactive SVG icons.

components.button_clay: Requires custom CSS for 3D look. lime bg, #020302 text.
components.card: bg-[#0A0B0A] border border-[#1A1C1A] rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden hover:border-[#334000] transition-colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the redesign using React (.js files, NOT .tsx) and Tailwind CSS.
Implement the strict Dark/Lime luxury aesthetic as defined.
Ensure 'btn-clay' class is globally defined in CSS to keep the 3D clay-style lime buttons exactly as requested.
Strictly follow the user's explicit removals: NO stats strip in the hero, NO micro-labels ('Vertex Neural Core', 'AI Signal Engine · v4.2 live') in the hero card.
The hero card MUST ONLY contain the SVG candlestick chart, floating 'BUY' marker, and caption 'Powered by Vertex AI real-time algorithm'.
Add the fading lime divider under the hero card.
Remove '01/02' numbers from the features section.
Redesign the 'Choose your access' section to look professional, distinct, and premium. Contrast the Free (step-by-step UI) and Paid ($99/mo) paths effectively.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Align text logically.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays. Ensure text readability with backdrop blur and semi-transparent solid colors.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
